paras: DIXCEL 2-Piece Front Rotor Replacement Hardware Kit (Incl. Bobbins) – Honda Civic Type R (FK8 / FL5)

A complete genuine DIXCEL hardware rebuild kit for the 2-piece floating front rotors on the Honda Civic Type R FK8 and FL5. This kit suits both the factory (OEM) 2-piece front rotors and DIXCEL replacement rotor rings, making it the easiest way to fully refresh your rotor assemblies when fitting new rings or servicing worn hardware.
